result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): A hits every rubric item: a 7-token scale tied to roles, helper text darkened to meet 4.5:1, labels moved to sentence case or tracked caps, headings at 1.2–1.3, and body text at 14–16px in rem. B is strong but weaker on two items. It keeps helper text at 12px, only conditionally raising it to body size when a hint is required, and it sets body at 14px only. Its tabular-nums step is off-topic. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B handles helper text more concretely: it gives a WCAG 4.5:1 contrast target with a specific color. It also gives reasons for its recommendations, sets 16px body as an option, and adds enforcement. A leaves 12px helper text in its scale and only advises checking contrast. A's tabular-nums step is off-topic.
